name: fclones-scheduler
description: Runs the fclones duplicate finder on a schedule and gets back the disk space that duplicate files take. Scans your share every 3 hours by default, or when your own scheduler asks. Replaces each extra copy with a hardlink or a copy-on-write clone, deletes it, or only reports it, and logs each duplicate it found and the space it freed. The default action only reports, so switch to link, remove or dedupe once a report has shown you what it would touch. No web UI, no open port.

paths.name: Scan path
paths.description: The share or folder to scan for duplicates, for example /mnt/user/Media. link, remove and dedupe need it read-write

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: The fclones hash cache and the last-scan record, which keep rescans fast and the schedule stable across restarts

variables.name: Action
variables.description: What to do with duplicates: group reports only, link replaces them with hardlinks, remove deletes them and dedupe makes copy-on-write clones. Anything but group modifies your files

variables.name: Scan interval
variables.description: Time between scans as a Go duration such as 3h, 12h or 24h. off turns the schedule off so you trigger scans yourself, and 0 runs one scan and exits

variables.name: Scan paths
variables.description: Container paths to scan, separated by spaces. Each needs its own path mapping. Leave at /scandir unless you add more mappings

variables.name: Scan arguments
variables.description: Extra flags for the fclones group phase, the scan, such as --name '*.mkv' --name '*.mp4' or --rf-over 1. Flags and their values only

variables.name: Action arguments
variables.description: Extra flags for the action phase, such as --priority bottom. --dry-run previews the action without changing files

variables.name: Scan timeout
variables.description: Timeout for each phase as a Go duration. Raise it when a first scan of a large share exceeds 12h. 0 turns it off

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error

variables.name: Allow unsafe arguments
variables.description: Set to true to allow the --transform, --in-place and --no-copy fclones flags, which are refused by default
